nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Peace, justice and strong institutions|Transparent institutions|Institutional accountability measures_qna_000
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What responsibility do institutions have in relation to the epistemic behavior of individuals, as discussed in the collection?
nodes.answer: Institutions have a responsibility to provide individuals with the tools necessary for developing good epistemic conduct through public education, as individuals may engage in epistemic misconduct as a result of inadequate education.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Peace, justice and strong institutions|Transparent institutions|Institutional accountability measures_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What responsibility do institutions have regarding the epistemic behavior of individuals, particularly in the context of public education?
nodes.answer: Institutions have a responsibility to provide individuals with the necessary tools for developing good epistemic conduct, as failing to do so may lead individuals to engage in epistemic misconduct when expressing themselves as policymakers, such as during voting or public debate.
